paper_claim: LISA-style person-specific routing tokens can jointly adapt Qwen Vision and Qwen LLM for reliable human mask and pose perception while preserving native text decoding for grounding and attributes.
hypothesis: A short textual Human Slot containing box, age, gender, <POSE>, and <SEG> avoids raw dense-token hallucination. Dense mask and pose losses routed through token hidden states and Qwen-native spatial features will explicitly teach Qwen Vision human structure.
falsifier: Close the branch if Qwen-native <SEG>/<POSE> routing cannot overfit 64 images, if the 5K predicted-box pilot remains below mask/pose gates, or if adapted Qwen Vision fails frozen human probes.

representation.decoder: native Qwen text decoder for Human Slot, box, gender, and age; LISA-style <SEG> and <POSE> hidden-state routing into mature Qwen-native dense decoders
representation.owner_binding: Each generated <POSE> and <SEG> belongs to the surrounding person slot and generated box; slots match GT by generated-box Hungarian matching.
representation.box: loc1000 tokens through the tied Qwen LM head.
representation.attributes: native text/special tokens through the tied Qwen LM head.
representation.segment: <SEG> hidden state -> projector -> SAM-style prompt; Qwen Vision multi-scale dense map is the sole mainline image embedding.
representation.pose: <POSE> hidden state -> projector/FiLM -> mature box-conditioned SimCC decoder over ROI-aligned Qwen Vision dense features.
representation.human_id: The textual person slot plus generated box is the identity shared by text, pose, and mask.

architecture.qwen_vision: Single full-image Qwen Vision encoder. Tap pre-merger blocks 8, 16, 24, project to 256 channels, and build a standard FPN dense map. The normal merger supplies image tokens to Qwen LLM.
architecture.qwen_llm: Qwen text decoder generates short multi-person slots and per-person <POSE>/<SEG> routing tokens.
architecture.seg_decoder: Reuse SAM/SAM2 mask-decoder architecture and compatible initialization, but no SAM image encoder in the mainline. Inputs are Qwen dense features, positional encoding, generated box prompt, and projected <SEG> state.
architecture.pose_decoder: Reuse mature SimCC coordinate classification with a shallow ROI transformer. ROIAlign uses the person box and projected <POSE> state modulates 17 joint queries. LLM generates no joint coordinates.
architecture.exact_lisa_control: Frozen SAM image encoder plus LISA decoder is segmentation upper-bound/control only.
architecture.pose_teacher_control: Frozen ViTPose/RTMPose on the same boxes is pose upper-bound/control only.

frozen_mainline: all original Qwen weights outside LoRA

losses.text: next-token CE for slot grammar, box, gender, age, routing tokens
losses.total: active-task normalized pre-registered weights; no validation tuning

training.phase_1_decoder_warmup: Freeze Qwen; train dense adapters, routing projectors, mask and pose decoders with GT boxes for 2,000 steps.
training.phase_2_joint_tuning: Train Vision LoRA, merger, LLM LoRA, token rows, projectors and decoders; use 50% GT and 50% bounded-jitter boxes for two epochs.
training.phase_3_generated_box_finish: Use generated boxes for dense branches while freezing original Qwen weights and finishing adapters/decoders for one epoch.
training.resolution: Approximately one-megapixel native-aspect input; ROIAlign only inside pose decoder.

checks: dense-loss gradients in Qwen Vision LoRA
base versus Stage-1 frozen mask probe
base versus Stage-1 frozen keypoint probe
visual_learning_proof.interpretation: Dense AP alone is insufficient because a specialist could solve the task; Qwen Vision features themselves must improve.

requirements: distinct person slots yield distinct <SEG>/<POSE> states
mask loss reaches Vision LoRA and <SEG> projector
pose loss reaches Vision LoRA and <POSE> projector
no SAM/ViTPose image encoder in mainline
G0_codec.decision: No GPU training before interface and shortcut tests pass.

G2_pilot_generated_validation.visual_probe_requirement: Adapted frozen Qwen Vision beats base on mask and keypoint probes.
G2_pilot_generated_validation.decision: No full run unless all task and visual-learning gates pass.

G3_full_stage1.decision: Stage-2 starts only when all metrics and visual probes pass.

controls: exact LISA with SAM image encoder
non_contributions: a new segmentation or pose architecture
reopen_policy: If a Qwen-native decoder fails task-only 5K, replace only that decoder with its exact mature external control; never return to raw contour or raw multi-person keypoint generation.

execution_override.prior_pilot_accuracy_gates: diagnostic; not a veto on the user-requested full run
execution_override.implemented_schedule: completed decoder warmup, then two full joint epochs; generated-box finish is not silently included
execution_override.implemented_resolution: native source image size with current processor; not upscaled to one megapixel
execution_override.implemented_mask_decoder: QwenNativeMaskDecoder; custom SAM-style cross-attention, no SAM pretrained decoder weights
execution_override.parameter_mode: Vision and LLM LoRA plus full merger, routing rows, adapters and decoders
